name: bac-thesis
description: Automated detection of Broken Access Control vulnerabilities in REST APIs: a role-aware testing tool in JavaScript (thesis artifact).

scripts.scan:ci: node cli-tool/src/cli.js scan --spec test-api/openapi.yaml --config cli-tool/config/example.config.yaml --target http://localhost:3000 --out reports/findings-vulnerable.json --fail-on none && node cli-tool/src/cli.js scan --spec test-api/openapi.yaml --config cli-tool/config/example.config.yaml --target http://localhost:3001 --out reports/findings-patched.json --fail-on none
